title: Eng MDM-Sharepoint Power Platform
description:
**What success looks like in this role:**

* 3-4 years' experience consulting or working in the enterprise customer arena
* 3-4 years' experience designing, developing and supporting business applications on the Microsoft stack, with 3+ years hands-on in Microsoft Power Platform
* 2–3 years' experience with Power BI development and M365 / SharePoint Online administration
* Extensive experience designing and implementing Power Platform solutions, including: Canvas and model-driven Power Apps (responsive design, Power Fx, component libraries, PCF controls)Power Automate cloud flows, desktop flows (RPA), approvals, error handling and run monitoring Dataverse data modelling, relationships, business rules, security roles, plug-ins and custom APIs Standard, premium and custom connectors; integration with SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, SQL Server, Azure (Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault) and REST APIs Copilot Studio agents and AI Builder models embedded in apps and flows Environment strategy, DLP policies, managed environments, CoE Starter Kit and tenant governance ALM — solution layering, Power Platform Pipelines / Azure DevOps, Power Platform CLI and source control
* Extensive experience writing, editing and maintaining PowerShell scripts (including Power Platform admin and Power BI management modules); working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and C# for extensions
* Power BI core skills: Power Query (M) ingestion and transformation, dataflows, on-premises data gateway Star-schema data modelling, DAX measures, calculation groups and performance tuning Report and dashboard design — visuals, bookmarks, drill-through, mobile layouts, accessibility Row-level security, workspaces, apps, deployment pipelines, scheduled refresh and tenant settings Embedding Power BI in Power Apps / Teams with write-back via Power Automate; familiarity with Microsoft Fabric
* Experience designing and implementing SharePoint Online lists and libraries as application data sources and document repositories
* Extensive experience performing discovery and writing scoping and levels of effort for delivering solutions that meet customer business, functional and technical requirements
* Face-to-face customer engagement skills
* Excellent written, oral and presentation skills
* Ability to explain technical procedures in business terms so that customers understand
* Ability to develop strategic customer relationships, gain trust and respect for the team
* Able to solve complex technical problems through sound and methodical troubleshooting (flow failures, delegation and app performance, DAX/query performance)
* Microsoft PL-400 (Power Platform Developer Associate) and/or PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst Associate) certification highly desired
* Hands-on experience migrating legacy automations (Nintex, InfoPath, SharePoint Designer workflows, MS Access) to Power Platform

#LI-UG1

**You will be successful in this role if you have:**

BA/BS degree and 3-5 years’ relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience

title: Sustaining Software Engineer (Android)
description:
**Why Verifone**
----------------



For more than 30 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.



Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it's developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.



Verifone is proudly an in\-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co\-located.


**What's exciting about the role**
----------------------------------



This role offers the opportunity to build Android applications that power real\-world payment solutions, from concept to production. You'll work on innovative payment devices, create demos and integrations, solve complex customer challenges, drive performance improvements, and collaborate across product and engineering teams while gaining valuable fintech and platform expertise.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Design, develop, and maintain on\-device and off\-device Android applications for Verifone payment
* Develop proof\-of\-concepts and demos that showcase Verifone product offerings, integrations, and workflows.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with product, engineering, and support teams.
* Contribute to transformation initiatives, including performance optimization, debugging and testing tools, and release readiness.
* Debug, analyze, and resolve customer\-reported issues; provide support for production defects.
* Participate in test automation, CI/CD improvements, and technical documentation efforts.


**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------


* Strong experience developing Android applications
* Proficiency in Java and/or Kotlin.
* Solid understanding of Android application architecture, lifecycle management, and performance optimization.
* Experience with RESTful APIs, backend integration, and asynchronous/event\-driven communication.
* Familiarity with software architecture concepts, including microservices and distributed systems.
* Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Exposure to containerized environments (Docker; Kubernetes/EKS is a plus).
* Experience debugging complex systems across device, OS, and network layers.
* Familiarity with or interest in using AI\-assisted development tools to improve productivity and code quality.


**Qualifications**
------------------


* Bachelor's Degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (preferred).
* 6\+ years of experience in Android or embedded/mobile software development.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively across teams.
* Proven ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a willingness to dive deep into unfamiliar systems and "look under the hood."


**Our commitment**
------------------



Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

title: IOS Developer
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*


iOS developer:  

Roles \& Responsibilities  

  

Design, develop, test, and maintain high\-quality iOS applications.  

Own mobile application development lifecycle end\-to\-end, including requirements, implementation, deployment, and support.  

Collaborate with product managers, designers, backend teams, and QA to deliver scalable solutions.  

Ensure performance, security, and quality standards are met.  

Manage app releases, App Store submissions, and versioning.  

Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for reliability and performance.  

Follow enterprise coding standards, review code, and contribute to technical documentation.  

Mandatory Technical Skills  

  

Strong experience with Swift and iOS SDK.  

Good understanding of UIKit / SwiftUI, Auto Layout, and iOS design guidelines.  

Experience with RESTful APIs, JSON parsing, and networking.  

Hands\-on experience with iOS app deployment, provisioning profiles, certificates, and App Store release process.  

Familiarity with source control systems (Git).  

Knowledge of mobile app security best practices.  

Experience working with enterprise\-grade applications.  

Good to Have Skills  

  

Experience with CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps (e.g., Fastlane).  

Exposure to Objective‑C.  

Knowledge of mobile analytics, crash reporting, and monitoring tools.  

Experience with unit testing and UI testing frameworks.  

Understanding of Agile/Scrum development processes.  

Behavioral \& Soft Skills  

  

Ability to work independently and take ownership of project requirements.  

Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.  

Good communication skills and stakeholder coordination capability.  

Proactive mindset with attention to detail.  

Ability to work in fast\-paced, enterprise\-scale environments

  

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!


Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking *Introduce Yourself* in the top\-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!
